steps.title: How to install it

open.windows: Open the downloaded file and follow the steps. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info" then "Run anyway".
open.linux: Open the downloaded file to install it. For the version with no installation, right-click the file, Properties, and tick "Allow executing".
open.macos: Open the downloaded file and drag the application into the Applications folder.

steps.server: At first launch, the application asks for the server address. Enter this one:
